scope: Prevent DWG LEADER serialization from silently dropping an associated-annotation hard pointer that the writer cannot yet resolve and emit.

research.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 20.4.47
facts: The code-340 associated annotation is a hard pointer, activated in R14.

implementation.behavior: DRW_Leader::encodeDwg refuses nonzero annotHandle, AnnotH.ref, or AnnotH.ref64 before emitting the entity body; null annotation references retain the existing encoding route.
implementation.positiveControl: After clearing the unsupported annotation edge, the same DWG writer successfully encodes the LEADER.

limits.worktree: uncommitted; shared checkout contains broad pre-existing edits
